choice_prompt:2:1041408001.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，我发现了一封请柬，信里邀请我们去宴会！
choice_prompt:2:1041408001.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look! I found an invitation for a banquet!
choice_prompt:2:1041408001.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look! I found an invitation for a banquet!

say:3:1041408002:1.text: You must've been feeling bored too! This might be fun to check out. Let me see. It's... tonight?!
say:3:1041408002:1.source_cn: 主人也感到无聊了吗！我看看……就在今天晚上？！
say:3:1041408002:1.male: You must've been feeling bored too! This might be fun to check out. Let me see. It's... tonight?!
say:3:1041408002:1.female: You must've been feeling bored too! This might be fun to check out. Let me see. It's... tonight?!

say:4:1041408004:1.text: Hmm, "Banquet of Joy"... Lemme skip all the boring details... yadda yadda...
say:4:1041408004:1.source_cn: 唔，“愉快的宴会”……中间部分全是花里花哨的没用信息，...

say:6:1041408005:1.text: "At the moon's rise tonight, we sincerely invite your presence. Sincerely..." Huuuh?!
say:6:1041408005:1.source_cn: “今夜月上之时，诚邀光临”……咦咦咦咦？！

choice_prompt:7:1041408005.text: "At the moon's rise tonight, we sincerely invite your presence. Sincerely..." Huuuh?!
choice_prompt:7:1041408005.source_cn: “今夜月上之时，诚邀光临”……咦咦咦咦？！

say:8:1041408006:1.text: I was wondering when you'd get to see my invitation.
say:8:1041408006:1.source_cn: 我还在想你们什么时候才能看到我的邀请。

say:10:1041408008:1.text: No wonder there was a bright flash of light when the invitation appeared!
say:10:1041408008:1.source_cn: 怪不得刚才眼前一花，一道光闪过，请柬就送来了！

say:11:1041408009:1.text: My spear always finds the right direction. For esteemed guests like you, seeing the invitation arrive with a spear like a shooting star is a spectacle, isn't it?
say:11:1041408009:1.source_cn: 我的矛尖总能找到正确的方向，对于尊贵的客人们来说，能看...

say:12:1041408010:1.text: So, what do you say? Will I see you at the banquet I meticulously prepared?
say:12:1041408010:1.source_cn: 所以，怎么样，我能在精心准备的宴会上看到诸位的身影吗？

choice_prompt:13:1041408010.text: So, what do you say? Will I see you at the banquet I meticulously prepared?
choice_prompt:13:1041408010.source_cn: 所以，怎么样，我能在精心准备的宴会上看到诸位的身影吗？

say:14:1041408011:1.text: I'll be awaiting your grand arrival.
say:14:1041408011:1.male: I'll be awaiting your grand arrival.
say:14:1041408011:1.female: I'll be awaiting your grand arrival.

say:15:1041408013:1.text: Speaking of which, Archon Dionel, I was wondering...
say:15:1041408013:1.source_cn: ……说到这个，萨基塔里斯大人，我在想。

say:16:1041408014:1.text: Wouldn't there be a risk of your light spear accidentally hurting a guest while delivering letters?
say:16:1041408014:1.source_cn: 您的光矛，不会在送信时出现偏差，射中某位客人吗？

say:17:1041408015:1.text: Aha, are you doubting my aim? Do not fret, the chance of that happening is one in a million.
say:17:1041408015:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，能被我的光矛击中，那是一种幸运啊。

say:19:1041408012:1.text: Oh! My dear Merlin, you always know where to strike where it hurts. You're so cold-hearted sometimes!
say:19:1041408012:1.source_cn: 连个理由都没有，就直接拒绝了吗？真令人伤心。
say:19:1041408012:1.male: Oh! My dear Merlin, you always know where to strike where it hurts. You're so cold-hearted sometimes!
say:19:1041408012:1.female: Oh! My dear Merlin, you always know where to strike where it hurts. You're so cold-hearted sometimes!
